```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)

pars_summary <- params$pars_summary
errors_summary <- params$errors_summary
comparison <- params$comparison

# Formatting: coverage as whole %, bias to 1 dp
rng_pct <- function(lo, hi) sprintf("%.0f%% to %.0f%%", lo, hi)
rng_b   <- function(lo, hi) sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", lo, hi)
```

Comparison: **`r comparison`**. All values are calculated from the same data as the figures.

```{r}
quoted_scenario <- list(

    "mean",     "All scenarios",           "95% CrI coverage",

    "mean",     "High variability",        "Bias 2.5th-97.5th",
    "cv",       "All scenarios",           "95% CrI coverage",
    "cv",       "n = 10\\)",               "Bias 2.5th-97.5th",
    "q95",      "n = 10\\)",               "Bias 2.5th-97.5th",
    "q95",      "All scenarios",           "95% CrI coverage",
    "cv",       "Lognormal",               "Median rel. bias",
    "q95",      "n = 10\\)",               "Median rel. bias",
    "cv",       "n = 10\\)",               "Median rel. bias",
    "q95",      "High variability",        "Median rel. bias",

    "check_95", ".",                       "Community Alive",

  )
)

highlight_scen <- function(df, tbl) {
  q <- quoted_scenario[[comparison]]
  if (is.null(q)) return(df)
  q <- filter(q, table == tbl)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(q))) {
    idx <- str_detect(as.character(df$scenario), q$scenario[i])
    df[[q$col[i]]][idx] <- paste0("**", df[[q$col[i]]][idx], "**")
  }
  df
}
```

# Delay estimation

Each row gives the range across the delays within that scenario. Coverage is the percentage of simulations in which the CrI contained the true value. Bias is the median relative bias across simulations. The last column is the widest 2.5th-97.5th percentile range of relative bias for any delay in that scenario.

```{r, results = "asis"}
# Per delay first, then summarised to scenario level
summarise_par <- function(pars, which_par) {
  pars %>%
    filter(par == which_par) %>%
    mutate(rel_bias = (median - true_value) / true_value * 100) %>%
    group_by(scenario, par_label) %>%
    summarise(
      cov_95      = mean(true_value >= q2.5 & true_value <= q97.5) * 100,
      cov_50      = mean(true_value >= q25  & true_value <= q75)   * 100,
      median_bias = median(rel_bias, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower_bias  = quantile(rel_bias, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_bias  = quantile(rel_bias, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

scenario_table <- function(by_delay) {
  by_delay %>%
    summarise(
      `95% CrI coverage`  = rng_pct(min(cov_95), max(cov_95)),
      `50% CrI coverage`  = rng_pct(min(cov_50), max(cov_50)),
      `Median rel. bias`  = rng_b(min(median_bias), max(median_bias)),
      `Bias 2.5th-97.5th` = rng_b(min(lower_bias), max(upper_bias))
    )
}

labels <- c(mean = "Mean", cv = "Coefficient of variation", q95 = "95th quantile")

for (p in names(labels)) {
  d <- summarise_par(pars_summary, p)
  cat("\n\n## ", labels[[p]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(kable(highlight_scen(bind_rows(
    scenario_table(group_by(d, scenario)),
    mutate(scenario_table(d), scenario = "All scenarios")
  ), p)))
}
```

# Error classification

Calculated as in `plot.R`. Individual-level rates are per dataset and pathway group, summarised as the median (IQR) across the 100 datasets. Event-level rates are pooled across datasets for each group and event, as in the heatmaps. **Bold** cells are quoted in the Results text.

```{r}
# Cells quoted in the text
quoted_individual <- tribble(
  ~threshold, ~group,              ~col,
  0.95,       "Community Alive",   "Individual sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Hospitalised Dead", "Individual sensitivity"
)

quoted_event <- tribble(
  ~threshold, ~group,               ~event,   ~col,
  0.95,       "Community Alive",    "onset",  "Sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Community Alive",    "report", "Sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Community Dead",     "death",  "Sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Community Dead",     "onset",  "Sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Hospitalised Dead",  "death",  "Sensitivity",
  0.95,       "Hospitalised Alive", "onset",  "Sensitivity",
  0.50,       "Community Alive",    "onset",  "Sensitivity",
  0.50,       "Community Alive",    "report", "Sensitivity"
)

# Bold the quoted cells in a formatted table
highlight <- function(df, quoted) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(quoted))) {
    q   <- quoted[i, ]
    idx <- df$threshold == q$threshold & as.character(df$group) == q$group
    if ("event" %in% names(q)) idx <- idx & df$event == q$event
    df[[q$col]][idx] <- paste0("**", df[[q$col]][idx], "**")
  }
  df
}

ind <- errors_summary %>%
  filter(event == "individual") %>%
  mutate(
    sens = if_else(n_true_errors > 0,
                   n_true_errors_flagged / n_true_errors * 100, NA_real_),
    spec = if_else(n_true_non_errors > 0,
                   (n_true_non_errors - n_false_positives) / n_true_non_errors * 100, NA_real_)
  )

ind_group <- ind %>%
  group_by(scenario, threshold, group) %>%
  summarise(
    sens_med = median(sens, na.rm = TRUE),
    sens_q25 = quantile(sens, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    sens_q75 = quantile(sens, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_med = median(spec, na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_q25 = quantile(spec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_q75 = quantile(spec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Drop events that don't occur in a group
ev <- errors_summary %>%
  filter(event != "individual") %>%
  group_by(scenario, threshold, group, event) %>%
  summarise(
    sens = if_else(sum(n_true_errors) > 0,
                   sum(n_true_errors_flagged) / sum(n_true_errors) * 100, NA_real_),
    spec = if_else(sum(n_true_non_errors) > 0,
                   (sum(n_true_non_errors) - sum(n_false_positives)) /
                     sum(n_true_non_errors) * 100, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(sens) & is.na(spec)))

rng1 <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_character_ else
  sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE))

scenario_error_table <- function(which, thr) {
  med <- paste0(which, "_med")
  i <- ind_group %>%
    filter(threshold == thr, !is.na(.data[[med]])) %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    summarise(`Individual: range of group medians` = rng1(.data[[med]]))
  e <- ev %>%
    filter(threshold == thr, !is.na(.data[[which]])) %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    summarise(
      `Event: range across group x event` = rng1(.data[[which]]),
      `Lowest group / event` =
        paste(group[which.min(.data[[which]])], event[which.min(.data[[which]])], sep = " / ")
    )
  inner_join(i, e, by = "scenario")
}
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
err_labels <- c(sens = "Sensitivity", spec = "Specificity")

col_key <- function(w) paste0(
  "Individual column: range of the per-group median ", tolower(w),
  " across the 100 datasets. Event columns: range across the heatmap tiles (",
  tolower(w), " pooled across datasets for each group and event), and the lowest tile.\n\n"
)

for (thr in c(0.95, 0.5)) {
  for (key in names(err_labels)) {
    cat("\n\n## ", err_labels[[key]], " (", thr * 100, "% threshold)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(col_key(err_labels[[key]]))
    print(kable(highlight_scen(scenario_error_table(key, thr), paste0(key, "_", thr * 100))))
  }
}
```

## Baseline scenario by pathway group

```{r, results = "asis"}
for (thr in c(0.95, 0.5)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", thr * 100, "% threshold\n\n", sep = "")

  ind_group %>%
    filter(str_detect(scenario, "Baseline"), threshold == thr) %>%
    transmute(threshold, group,
              `Individual sensitivity` = sprintf("%.0f%% (%.0f%% to %.0f%%)", sens_med, sens_q25, sens_q75),
              `Individual specificity` = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% to %.1f%%)", spec_med, spec_q25, spec_q75)) %>%
    arrange(group) %>%
    highlight(quoted_individual) %>%
    select(-threshold) %>%
    kable() %>%
    print()

  ev %>%
    filter(str_detect(scenario, "Baseline"), threshold == thr) %>%
    transmute(threshold, group, event,
              Sensitivity = sprintf("%.1f%%", sens),
              Specificity = sprintf("%.2f%%", spec)) %>%
    arrange(group, event) %>%
    highlight(quoted_event) %>%
    select(-threshold) %>%
    kable() %>%
    print()
}
```

## Checks for claims across scenarios

### Event-level sensitivity by group (95% threshold)

Lowest and highest event-level sensitivity in each pathway group. Checks whether community-alive < community-dead < hospitalised in every scenario.

```{r}
ev %>%
  filter(threshold == 0.95, !is.na(sens)) %>%
  group_by(scenario, group) %>%
  summarise(sens = sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", min(sens), max(sens)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = sens) %>%
  highlight_scen("check_95") %>%
  kable()
```

### Does lowering the threshold increase sensitivity everywhere?

Group and event combinations where sensitivity at the 50% threshold is lower than at 95%.

```{r}
decreases <- ev %>%
  filter(!is.na(sens)) %>%
  select(scenario, group, event, threshold, sens) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = threshold, values_from = sens) %>%
  filter(`0.5` < `0.95`)

if (nrow(decreases) == 0) {
  cat("No decreases: sensitivity is higher at the 50% threshold for every scenario, group and event.")
} else {
  kable(decreases, digits = 1)
}
```

# Convergence

```{r}
pars_summary %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    `% R-hat < 1.01` = mean(rhat < 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `% R-hat < 1.05` = mean(rhat < 1.05, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 1)
```

# Quick look-up

Claims in the Results text, the value(s) as written in the text currently, and the value calculated here. If the columns disagree, update the text.

```{r}
dl  <- lapply(c(mean = "mean", cv = "cv", q95 = "q95"),
              function(p) summarise_par(pars_summary, p))
mn <- dl$mean; cv <- dl$cv; q95 <- dl$q95

f0 <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)
f1 <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
r0 <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f%% to %.0f%%", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
r1 <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
sc <- function(df, pattern) filter(df, str_detect(as.character(scenario), pattern))
bias_pct <- function(df) r1(c(df$lower_bias, df$upper_bias))

ev95 <- filter(ev, threshold == 0.95)
ev50 <- filter(ev, threshold == 0.5)
ig95 <- filter(ind_group, threshold == 0.95)

if (comparison == "main_scenarios") {
  base_ev <- sc(ev, "Baseline")
  lowest50 <- ev50 %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(round(spec, 6)) > 1) %>%
    summarise(lowest = as.character(group[which.min(spec)]))
  
  lowest50_err <- filter(lowest50, !str_detect(scenario, "Missing dates only|No errors"))

  lookup <- tribble(
    ~Claim,                                               ~Text,              ~Report,
    "Mean: 95% CrI coverage, all scenarios",              "88% to 100%",      r0(mn$cov_95),
    "Mean: 50% CrI coverage, all scenarios",              "36% to 64%",       r0(mn$cov_50),
    "Mean: median relative bias, all scenarios",          "-8.1% to 2.1%",    r1(mn$median_bias),
    "Mean: bias 2.5th-97.5th, n = 10",                    "largest effect on precision",           bias_pct(sc(mn, "n = 10\\)")),
    "Mean: bias 2.5th-97.5th, n = 20",                    "largest effect on precision",           bias_pct(sc(mn, "n = 20\\)")),
    "Mean: bias 2.5th-97.5th, high variability",          "largest effect on precision",            bias_pct(sc(mn, "High variability")),
    "CV: 95% CrI coverage, all scenarios",                "87% to 100%",      r0(cv$cov_95),
    "q95: 95% CrI coverage, all scenarios",               "87% to 100%",      r0(q95$cov_95),
    "CV: lowest median bias, n = 10",                     "-14.9%",           f1(min(sc(cv, "n = 10\\)")$median_bias)),
    "q95: lowest median bias, n = 10",                    "-12.5%",           f1(min(sc(q95, "n = 10\\)")$median_bias)),
    "q95: lowest median bias, high variability",          "-8.1%",            f1(min(sc(q95, "High variability")$median_bias)),
    "CV: median bias, log-normal delays",                 "3.6% to 9.5%",     r1(sc(cv, "Lognormal")$median_bias),
    "Baseline: individual sensitivity (95%), group medians", "88% to 100%",   r0(sc(ig95, "Baseline")$sens_med),
    "Baseline: community-alive individual sensitivity (95%)", "100%",         f0(filter(sc(ig95, "Baseline"), group == "Community Alive")$sens_med),
    "Baseline: community-alive event sensitivity (95%)",  "below 1%",         r1(filter(base_ev, threshold == 0.95, group == "Community Alive")$sens),
    "Baseline: community-dead event sensitivity (95%)",   "53% to 55%",       r1(filter(base_ev, threshold == 0.95, group == "Community Dead")$sens),
    "Baseline: hospitalised event sensitivity (95%)",     "67% to 79%",       r1(filter(base_ev, threshold == 0.95, str_detect(group, "Hospitalised"))$sens),
    "Community-alive event sensitivity (95%), max over scenarios", "below 2%", f1(max(filter(ev95, group == "Community Alive")$sens, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Errors only: community-dead event sensitivity (95%)", "84% to 86%",      r1(filter(sc(ev95, "Errors only"), group == "Community Dead")$sens),
    "Errors only: hospitalised event sensitivity (95%)",  "81% to 91%",       r1(filter(sc(ev95, "Errors only"), str_detect(group, "Hospitalised"))$sens),
    "Baseline: community-alive event sensitivity (50%)",  "58% to 59%",       r1(filter(base_ev, threshold == 0.5, group == "Community Alive")$sens),
    "Sensitivity lower at 50% than 95% (any cell)",       "no",             as.character(nrow(decreases)),
    "Individual specificity (95%), lowest group median",  "100%",             f1(min(ig95$spec_med, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Event specificity (95%), minimum",                   "99.8%",            f1(min(ev95$spec, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Event specificity (50%), minimum excl. high error",  "95.9%",            f1(min(filter(ev50, !str_detect(scenario, "High error"))$spec, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "High error: event specificity (50%), minimum",       "80.9%",            f1(min(sc(ev50, "High error")$spec, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Scenarios with errors where community-alive is lowest (50% spec)", "all", sprintf("%d of %d", sum(lowest50_err$lowest == "Community Alive"), nrow(lowest50_err))
  )
}

if (comparison == "misspecification_scenarios") {
  ind_pat <- "Misspecify independent"

  lookup <- tribble(
    ~Claim,                                               ~Text,              ~Report,
    "Mean: median bias, wrong distribution family",       "-2.6% to 1.8%",    r1(sc(mn, "Misspecify (gamma|lognormal)")$median_bias),
    "Log-normal fitted as gamma: CV median bias",         "-11.8% to -8.3%",  r1(sc(cv, "Misspecify gamma")$median_bias),
    "Log-normal fitted as gamma: q95 median bias",        "-9.2% to -6.0%",   r1(sc(q95, "Misspecify gamma")$median_bias),
    "Gamma fitted as log-normal: CV median bias",         "14.4% to 19.8%",   r1(sc(cv, "Misspecify lognormal")$median_bias),
    "Gamma fitted as log-normal: q95 median bias",        "7.6% to 11.4%",    r1(sc(q95, "Misspecify lognormal")$median_bias),
    "Correlated delays: median bias, mean/CV/q95",        "-4.2% to 6.9%",    r1(c(sc(mn, ind_pat)$median_bias, sc(cv, ind_pat)$median_bias, sc(q95, ind_pat)$median_bias)),
    "Correlated delays: 95% CrI coverage, mean and q95",  "91% to 98%",       r0(c(sc(mn, ind_pat)$cov_95, sc(q95, ind_pat)$cov_95)),
    "Correlated delays: 95% CrI coverage, CV minimum",    "84%",              f0(min(sc(cv, ind_pat)$cov_95)),
    "Community-alive event sensitivity (95%), max",       "below 1%",         f1(max(filter(sc(ev95, "Misspecify"), group == "Community Alive")$sens, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Pattern held: max community-dead vs min hospitalised sensitivity (95%)",       "CD < hosp",        sprintf("%s vs %s",
                                                                                f1(max(filter(sc(ev95, "Misspecify"), group == "Community Dead")$sens, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                                                f1(min(filter(sc(ev95, "Misspecify"), str_detect(group, "Hospitalised"))$sens, na.rm = TRUE))),
    "Gamma fitted as log-normal: individual sensitivity (95%)", "81% to 95%", r0(sc(ig95, "Misspecify lognormal")$sens_med),
    "Other misspecification: individual sensitivity (95%)", "88% to 100%",    r0(sc(ig95, "Misspecify (gamma|independent)")$sens_med),
    "Event specificity (95%), minimum",                   "99.9%",            f1(min(sc(ev95, "Misspecify")$spec, na.rm = TRUE)),
    "Sensitivity lower at 50% than 95% (any cell)",       "no",             as.character(nrow(decreases))
  )
}

if (exists("lookup")) kable(lookup) else cat("No look-up defined for this comparison.")
```
